content: Question classification (QC) deals with question analysis and question labeling based on the expected answer type. The goal of QC is to assign classes accurately to the questions based on expected answer. In modern system, there are two types of questions BIBREF0. One is Factoid question which is about providing concise facts and another one is Complex question that has a presupposition which is complex. Question Answering (QA) System is an integral part of our daily life because of the high amount of usage of Internet for information acquisition. In recent years, most of the research works related to QA are based on English language such as IBM Watson, Wolfram Alpha. Bengali speakers often fall in difficulty while communicating in English BIBREF1.
